mustBlock.text: Thanks for writing. Our retainer is usually $2,500.
We work on a 33% basis so you pay nothing up front.
Good news: we offer a free consultation.
Based on what you said, you have a strong case.
We guarantee you will be happy with the result.
You will recover your lost wages.
You should not sign anything the insurance company sends you.
Do not talk to the insurance adjuster before we speak.
You are entitled to overtime pay for those hours.
We will represent you in this matter.
Thanks for reaching out — we can help.
Weekdays 9–5 work best for our team.

Hi Jordan,

Thank you for reaching out about the accident. Our team handles this kind of matter, and we would like to set up a consultation. Could you reply with a good phone number and two or three times that work for you?

Hi Helen,

Thanks for your note about planning your will. We help people with this often. What phone number and times work best for a short call?

Hi Ravi,

Thank you for writing. We would like to hear more about what happened at work. Please send a phone number and a few times you are free this week.
